e.title: **把一部**养老金法典**做成**可检索的数据集****：ModelScope `louisbrulenaudet/code-pensions-civiles-militaires-retraite`——**⭐ 逐字自述（英）**「**The objective of this project is to provide researchers, professionals and law students with simplified, up-to-date access to all French legal texts, enriched with a wealth of data to facilitate their integration into Community and European projects.**」**；**⭐ 并逐字声明**「**the data is refreshed daily on all legal codes**」**；**⭐ 每条**条文**的字段**被逐项写明**（**`ref`／**`texte`／**`dateDebut`／**`dateFin`／**`num`／**`id`／**`cid`**）**；**⭐ 并配一个**可批量加载多部法典的 **Python 库****（**逐字** `pip3 install ragoon`**）**；**⚠️ 而**它**只有 **453,928 字节**、**下载 **84 次****
e.title_en: A pension code turned into a searchable dataset: the project states its aim of giving researchers, professionals and law students simplified access to French legal texts, says the data is normally refreshed daily across all codes, documents each article field by field, and ships a Python library that loads several codes at once, while the stored size is about four hundred and fifty kilobytes and downloads stand at eighty-four.

e.summary_en: This ModelScope dataset **is an attempt to turn the French civil and military retirement pensions code into a machine-readable dataset**, stating verbatim that its objective is to give researchers, professionals and law students simplified and up-to-date access to French legal texts, and that the data is normally refreshed daily across all legal codes. **Measured this round**: an Apache licence, a stored size of about four hundred and fifty kilobytes, eighty-four downloads, created in October and last modified at the end of July. **This entry belongs to the round theme of a Chinese model and dataset platform, on its dataset side.** **Four things are worth reading: every article carries a documented field table covering a reference built from the code name and article number, the article text, its start and end dates, and identifiers including a chronological one, so a legal code becomes a structure that can be queried by time; the project also ships a companion tool that installs with one command and loads several codes at once, so a single code is only the entry point and the real form is the combined retrieval of many codes; it states that the data is refreshed daily, which makes the moment of validity a core property of this kind of dataset and is why the title carries its own date; and the size is small and downloads modest, which this entry records as narrow regulatory data, alongside two sibling pension codes by the same author that are not collected separately under the same-author near-duplicate rule.** **No data was downloaded this round.**
e.body:
**code-pensions-civiles-militaires-retraite**（ModelScope 数据集 `louisbrulenaudet/code-pensions-civiles-militaires-retraite`）**是把**法国《**文职与军职退休金法典**》**做成**机器可读数据集**的一次尝试****——**逐字自述（英）为**「**The objective of this project is to provide researchers, professionals and law students with simplified, up-to-date access to all French legal texts, enriched with a wealth of data to facilitate their integration into Community and European projects.**」**，**并**逐字声明**「**Normally, the data is refreshed daily on all legal codes, and aims to simplify the production of training sets and labeling pipelines for the development of free, open-source language models based on open data accessible to all.**」**。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**中国的模型与数据集平台：数据集这一面**」**。

**可核实信息（均 ModelScope 数据集接口实测）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 每条条文**有一个**逐项写明的字段表****——**⭐ 本次实测**其 **README** 用一节**逐字说明 **`item` 字典的字段**，**其中**逐字含**：**「**`ref` (string): Reference — a reference to the article, combining the title_main and the article `number`**」**、**「**`texte` (string): Text Content — the textual content of the article**」**、**「**`dateDebut` (string): Start Date — the date when the article came into effect**」**、**「**`dateFin` (string): End Date — the date when the article was terminated or superseded**」**、**「**`num` (string): Article Number**」**、**「**`id` (string): Article ID**」与**「**`cid` (string): Chronical ID**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为**这一处**是本条最有价值的部分**：**⭐ 即**它**把**「**法规**」**拆成了**可以**按条文、**按生效与**失效日期**检索的**结构**——**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**养老金业务的**合规判断**往往**取决于**「**当时**哪一版**有效**」**，**而**这种**逐条带**起止日期的**数据**，**正好**支持**那种**按时间**回看的问题**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 单部法典只是入口，**真正的形态是**「**多部法典可合并检索**」****——**⭐ 本次实测**其 **README** 逐字给出**安装命令** `pip3 install ragoon`**，**并**逐字给出**用法**：**从 `ragoon` 导入 **`load_datasets`**，**传入一个**请求列表**（**逐字示例含** `louisbrulenaudet/code-artisanat` 与 **`louisbrulenaudet/code-action-sociale-familles`**）**，**再**用 `datasets.concatenate_datasets` **合并**。**⭐ 本词条认为**这一处**值得记**：**⭐ 即**同一位作者**在**同一个平台上**发布了**一套**按主题切分的**法典数据集**，**并**配了一个**把它们**拼起来**的**库**——**⭐ 这**比**「**一个巨大的法律语料**」**更适合**按主题**取用**。**⭐⭐ ③ 时点性是核心特征，**而**标题自带日期****——**⭐ 标题逐字为**「**Code des pensions civiles et militaires de retraite, non-instruct (2025-03-10)**」**，**即**它**在**名称里**带了**版本日期**与**「**未指令化**」的**标注**；**⭐ 而**说明**逐字承诺每日刷新**。**⭐ 本词条认为**这一处**值得抄**：**⭐ 即**法规类数据的**第一个问题**是**「**你这一版**是哪一天**的**」**——**⭐ 把**日期写进**名称**，**读者**一眼**就知道**。**⭐⭐ ④ 体量小而专，**且**其**同族**另有两条**被**本词条**按规则略去****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**存储 **453,928 字节**（**约 **450 KB**）**、**下载 **84 次**、**许可 **`apache-2.0`**、**创建 **2025-10-13T09:20:41Z**、**最后修改 **2026-07-30T09:08:16Z****；**⭐ 同作者**同批还有**「**code-pensions-militaires-invalidite-victimes-guerre**」（**86 次下载**）与**「**code-pensions-retraite-marins-francais-commerce-peche-plaisance**」（**72 次下载**）**，**三者**创建时间**同为 **2025-10-13****。**⭐ 本词条**按**同作者同形近重复**规则**只收这一条**，**并**明确声明**三者**未做**代码级或**内容级比较**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[openfisca-tunisia-pension]]、**[[pension-pro-mcp]] 覆盖**养老金规则与**数据接口**、**[[institut-des-actuaires]] 与**[[cee-longevity-tables]] 覆盖**法语圈的**精算机构与**长寿数据**——**⭐ 而**本条补上的是**「**把**一部养老金法典**做成**带生效／**失效日期的**逐条数据集**，**并**配**多法典合并加载工具**」这一形态**；**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较****。

**对 RIAA**：**⭐ 本条最值得借的四件事**：**① **法规数据**要**逐条带**生效与**失效日期**，**才能**回答**「**当时**哪一版**有效**」**；**② **版本日期**要写进**名称**；**③ **按主题切分**＋**一个合并加载工具**，**比一个**巨大语料**更好用**；**④ **小而专**的数据集**也**可以**很实用**。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**没有下载该数据集的任何内容**（**未校验**其**条文条数、**字段完整性**与**日期覆盖**）**，**故**不主张**其**完整性**、**不主张**其**可替代**官方法规文本**、**也**不主张**其**与**官方版本**一致**。**② ⚠️ 本次**只读**数据集接口返回的**元数据与 **README**。**③ ⚠️ **未核实**「**每日刷新**」**这一自述**（**⭐ 本次**只见到**创建与**最后修改两个时点**）**。**④ ⚠️ **未核实**其**收录条文的**来源**（**⭐ README **未在本词条**读取的范围内**说明**数据来自**哪个官方源**）**。**⑤ ⚠️ **未核实**其**许可**是否**足以**覆盖**对**官方法规文本的**再分发**（**⭐ 卡片逐字为 **`apache-2.0`**）**。**⑥ ⚠️ **未核实**作者身份**与**其 **LegalKit 项目**的**整体范围**。**⑦ ⚠️ 本条目**所记为 **2026-09-11 所见**；**⚠️ 并如实提示**：**该数据集**不是**法律意见**，**其**条文**以**官方发布**为准**。

**code-pensions-civiles-militaires-retraite**（ModelScope 數據集 `louisbrulenaudet/code-pensions-civiles-militaires-retraite`）**是把**法國《**文職與軍職退休金法典**》**做成**機器可讀數據集**的一次嘗試****——**逐字自述（英）為**「**The objective of this project is to provide researchers, professionals and law students with simplified, up-to-date access to all French legal texts, enriched with a wealth of data to facilitate their integration into Community and European projects.**」**，**並逐字聲明**「**Normally, the data is refreshed daily on all legal codes**」**。**⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**中國的模型與數據集平台：數據集這一面**」**。

**可核實資訊（均 ModelScope 數據集介面實測）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 每條條文有逐項寫明的欄位表****——**其 README 用一節逐字說明 `item` 字典的欄位**，**逐字含** `ref`（**由法典名與條號拼成的引用**）、`texte`（**條文正文**）、`dateDebut`（**生效日**）、`dateFin`（**失效日**）、`num`、`id` 與 `cid`（**時序標識**）****。**⭐ 即**法規被拆成**可按條文、**按生效與**失效日期檢索的結構**——**⭐ 對 RIAA**：**養老金業務的合規判斷**往往取決於「**當時哪一版有效**」**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 單部法典只是入口，**真正形態是**多部法典可合併檢索****——**README 逐字給出 `pip3 install ragoon`**，**並以 `load_datasets(req=[...])` 一次加載多部法典**（**示例含 `louisbrulenaudet/code-artisanat` 與 `louisbrulenaudet/code-action-sociale-familles`**）**，**再用 `datasets.concatenate_datasets` 合併****。**⭐⭐ ③ 時點性是核心特徵，**而標題自帶日期****——**標題逐字為 Code des pensions civiles et militaires de retraite, non-instruct (2025-03-10)****；**⭐ 即**把版本日期寫進名稱**，**讀者一眼就知道**。**⭐⭐ ④ 體量小而專，**同族另有兩條被略去****——**存儲 453,928 位元組（**約 450 KB**）**、**下載 84 次**、**許可 `apache-2.0`**、**創建 2025-10-13T09:20:41Z**、**最後修改 2026-07-30T09:08:16Z****；**⭐ 同作者另有 code-pensions-militaires-invalidite-victimes-guerre（**86 次**）與 code-pensions-retraite-marins-francais-commerce-peche-plaisance（**72 次**）**，**三者創建時間同為 2025-10-13****。**⭐ 按同作者同形近重複規則只收這一條，**並聲明三者未做比較**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 與池內條目的關係**：[[openfisca-tunisia-pension]]、[[pension-pro-mcp]]、[[institut-des-actuaires]]、[[cee-longevity-tables]]——**⭐ 本條補上的是**「**把一部養老金法典做成帶生效／**失效日期的逐條數據集，**並配多法典合併加載工具**」這一形態**。

**對 RIAA**：**⭐ 四件事值得借**：**① **逐條帶生效與失效日期**；**② **版本日期寫進名稱**；**③ **按主題切分＋合併工具**；**④ **小而專也可以很實用**。

**⚠️ 本詞條如實標註**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**沒有下載該數據集的任何內容**，**不主張**其完整性**、**不主張**其可替代官方法規文本**，**也不主張**其與官方版本一致**。**② ⚠️ 本次**只讀數據集介面返回的元資料與 README**。**③ ⚠️ 未核實**「**每日刷新**」這一自述**（**本次只見到創建與最後修改兩個時點**）**。**④ ⚠️ 未核實**其收錄條文的來源**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核實**其許可是否足以覆蓋對官方法規文本的再分發**。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核實**作者身份與其 LegalKit 專案的整體範圍**。**⑦ ⚠️ 本條目所記為 2026-09-11 所見**；**⚠️ 該數據集不是法律意見**，**其條文以官方發布為準**。
e.body_en:
This ModelScope dataset **is an attempt to turn the French civil and military retirement pensions code into a machine-readable dataset**, stating verbatim that its objective is to give researchers, professionals and law students simplified and up-to-date access to French legal texts, and that the data is normally refreshed daily across all legal codes. **This entry belongs to the round theme of a Chinese model and dataset platform, on its dataset side.**

**Verified information, all measured from the platform dataset interface**: **first, every article carries a documented field table.** The readme devotes a section to the fields of the item dictionary, naming a reference that combines the code title with the article number, the article text itself, a start date and an end date described as the dates on which the article came into effect and was terminated or superseded, the article number, an article identifier and a chronological identifier. **That is the most valuable part of this entry: a legal code is broken into a structure that can be queried article by article and by dates of effect, which matters for this project because pension compliance questions usually turn on which version was in force at the time.** **Second, a single code is only the entry point, since the real form is combined retrieval across many codes.** The readme gives a one-line installation for a companion tool and an example that loads a list of code datasets at once, including codes for trades and for social and family action, then concatenates them. **The same author has published a set of topically split code datasets on one platform together with a library for joining them, which is more usable than one enormous legal corpus when a reader needs a single topic.** **Third, the moment of validity is a core property and the title carries its own date**: the title includes both a date and a note that the data is not instruction-tuned. **The first question about regulatory data is which day version you are reading, and putting the date in the name answers it at a glance.** **Fourth, the dataset is small and narrow, and two siblings are deliberately not collected here.** The stored size is about four hundred and fifty kilobytes with eighty-four downloads under an Apache licence, created in October and last modified at the end of July, while two further pension codes by the same author, covering military invalidity and war victims and the retirement of French marines in commerce, fishing and leisure, were created on the same day. **This entry collects only one of the three under the same-author near-duplicate rule and states explicitly that no comparison was made between them.** **Fifth, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover pension rules for one country, a pension data interface, and French-speaking actuarial institutions and longevity tables, **while this entry supplies an article-level pension code dataset with effect and termination dates plus a tool for loading several codes together. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**

**For RIAA**: **four practices transfer: carry effective and termination dates per article so that questions about which version was in force can be answered; put the version date in the name; split by topic and provide a joining tool rather than one huge corpus; and remember that a small, narrow dataset can still be useful.**
